name: geothermal-egs-placements
title: Global Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) plant placements with simulated power and LCOE (Franzmann et al. 2025)
description: File 4 of the Mendeley Data release that accompanies Franzmann, Heinrichs and Stolten (2025), Renewable Energy 250, 123199, mirrored unchanged: 4,075,483 location-specific Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) doublet plant placements, worldwide, published as "Raw data of the global location specific plants". Each row gives one plant: its point location (lon/lat, EPSG:4326), its GADM 3.6 level-1 region code (gid1), and the net power output and LCOE computed by three reservoir models: Gringarten, Volume Method and Sustainable Approach. Columns: lon, lat, gid1, Pout_Gringarten_MW, LCOE_Gringarten_Eurct_per_kWh, Pout_VolumeMethod_MW, LCOE_VolumeMethod_Eurct_per_kWh, Pout_Sustainable_MW, LCOE_Sustainable_Eurct_per_kWh.
